description:
Analysis code for the article:

Flores-García, E., Wojcik, D. Z., Huelmo-Ruiz, S., & Díez-Villoria, E. (2026). Autistic Trait Dimensions and Resting-State Neural Markers: A Multimodal EEG/fNIRS Study in Non-Clinical Adults. Applied Sciences, 16(19), 9850. https://doi.org/10.3390/app16199850

This repository contains the Python code and configuration needed to reproduce all analyses reported in the article and its Supplementary Materials: EEG preprocessing (extended Infomax ICA + ICLabel) and sensitivity branches, global and dynamic EEG connectivity, regional spectral power, EEG microstates, fNIRS ALFF/fALFF, EEG–fNIRS canonical correlation analysis, AQ × condition interactions, and the supplementary analyses and figures (S1–S8).

The resting-state EEG/fNIRS dataset (BIDS format) is not included; it is available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request. See README.md for setup and run instructions. License: MIT.
name: Autistic Trait Dimensions and Resting-State Neural Markers: A Multimodal EEG/fNIRS Study in Non-Clinical Adults

description: Intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) data offer a unique combination of high spatial and temporal resolution measures of the living human brain. However, data collection is limited to highly specialized clinical environments. To improve internal (re)use and external sharing of these unique data, we present a structure for storing and sharing iEEG data: BIDS-iEEG, an extension of the Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) specification, along with freely available examples and a bids-starter-kit. BIDS is a framework for organizing and documenting data and metadata with the aim to make datasets more transparent and reusable and to improve reproducibility of research. It is a community-driven specification with an inclusive decision-making process. As an extension of the BIDS specification, BIDS-iEEG facilitates integration with other modalities such as fMRI, MEG, and EEG. name: BIDS-iEEG: an extension to the Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) Specification for intracranial electroencephalography

This conversion currently only exports the fUSI-related content.

description:
Behavioral and raw EEG data associated with the manuscript "Semantic distance differently modulates FPVS-EEG responses to words and pictures" accepted in Neurobiology of Language. 
The structure of the dataset follows the BIDS format, with data for each subject stored in its own folder, separately for behavioral and EEG data.
